why: Image 2 reads as a real, specific room: the table globes pool warm light on wood tops, the banquette, bar, record wall and receding speakers give depth, and the materials (veneer, concrete, upholstery) hold up in crops, though the hard, sun-like shafts on the right wall are odd for night. Image 1 is mostly black frame around a small doorway view, and its flat glowing-red speakers and floating neon rings read as CG objects rather than light in a room.
